title: Suno로 원하는 노래 만들기
description: 김준호 교수의 17장 AI 음악 강의. 개인의 이야기와 메시지를 가사·장르·보컬·프롬프트로 설계하고 작품으로 발표하는 과정을 설명합니다.

ko.s2_lead: 개인이 자신의 이야기와 메시지를 음악이라는 미디어로 소유하게 된 사건이다.
ko.s7_p: Suno는 텍스트 프롬프트로 보컬, 가사, 편곡이 포함된 완성형 곡을 생성하는 AI 음악 도구다.
ko.s8_lead: 처음부터 정답을 뽑는 것이 아니라, 반복할 수 있는 기준을 만드는 것이 핵심이다.
ko.s10_3: 장르: 어떤 음악 문법을 빌릴 것인가
ko.s12_lead: 연주곡은 분위기를 운반하고, 보컬곡은 문장을 운반한다.
ko.s16_lead: “내가 지금 누군가에게 꼭 전하고 싶은 말”을 한 문장으로 쓰고, 그것을 후렴으로 바꾼다.
ko.s17_lead:
Suno를 배우는 것은 AI 버튼을 배우는 일이 아니라,
나의 이야기를 노래로 번역하는 법을 배우는 일이다.
ko.structure_note: 구간마다 맡은 역할이 다릅니다. 후렴에는 가장 남기고 싶은 말을 둡니다.
ko.brief_note: 모든 조건은 내가 전하려는 메시지를 향합니다.
ko.case_note: 실제 발표한 작품을 열어, 노래와 메시지가 만나는 방식을 살펴봅니다.
ko.lab_note: 강의에서 사용한 Sound Design Lab V2

en.s1_title:
Make the song
only you can tell.
en.s1_lead:
From public music
to your own music
en.s1_speaker: Prof. Junho Kim, Department of Electrical Engineering, Dong Seoul University
en.s2_title:
AI music is about
more than a hit.
en.s2_lead: It is the moment individuals gain ownership of music as a medium for their own stories and messages.
en.s3_lead: Private music is music that speaks.
en.s4_c1_p: Driven by markets, broadcasts, charts, and distribution
en.s4_c2_p: Driven by personal memory, relationships, and messages
en.s4_c3_p: Intent design matters more than composition technique
en.s5_title:
You can start without theory.
Start with structure.
en.s6_c2_p: The grammar and expectation of sound
en.s6_c4_p: Pop song, jingle, campaign song, commercial song
en.s7_p: Suno is an AI music tool that generates complete songs with vocals, lyrics, and arrangement from text prompts.
en.s8_title:
A better input.
A clearer next revision.
en.s8_lead: The key is not getting the perfect answer at once, but creating criteria you can iterate with.
en.s10_1: Story: Who is in what situation?
en.s10_2: Message: What should remain in the chorus?
en.s10_3: Genre: Which musical grammar will you borrow?
en.s10_4: Vocal: Who sings it, and with what emotion?
en.s12_title:
Instrumental or vocal?
Ask a different question.
en.s12_lead: Instrumentals carry atmosphere; vocal songs carry sentences.
en.s13_title:
From one sentence,
to a finished work.
en.s13_1: Define the message in one sentence
en.s13_3: Enter the prompt and generate the first version
en.s13_5: Publish as an album or landing page
en.s14_title:
Beyond an audio file.
A place for your message.
en.s14_c1_t: I Thought I Was Going Home
en.s15_title:
More than a button.
A design partner.
en.s15_p: Created by Prof. Junho Kim, Dong Seoul University
en.s16_title:
What do you want
someone to hear?
en.s16_lead: Write one sentence you truly want to say to someone now, then turn it into a chorus.
en.s17_lead:
Learning Suno is not learning an AI button;
it is learning how to translate your story into a song.
en.structure_note: Each section has a role. Put the message you want to remain in the chorus.
en.brief_note: Every choice serves the message you want to share.
en.case_note: Open the published works and see how each song carries its message.

en.practice_step: Write one sentence. Turn it into a chorus.
en.closing_note: Music is a medium for your own message.
